summary: Collects high-level requirements for tightly coupled SIP conferences, the kind where a central party manages the call. It examines a wide range of needs. Later documents are meant to map these onto existing protocol pieces and to define new extensions, together forming a guide for interoperable SIP conferencing applications.

eli5.summary: Before building a group phone call system, you list everything it should do. This memo is that list, so the later building plans can be checked against it.
